surface_mechanism_description: Amorphous CaCO3 films were converted to hydroxyapatite by wet treatment in dilute phosphate solution. The conversion was examined in relation to temperature, phosphate concentration and pH of the solution. At 80 and 95 °C, the formation of platelike nanocrystals was observed when the samples were treated with 0.2 M DAP or 0.2 M DAP in 1 M NH3 solutions.
